2607.08339.title: TypeProbe: Recovering Type Representations from Hidden States of Pre-trained Code Models
2607.08339.paper_summary: State-of-the-art code models achieve impressive performance, yet the extent to which they internally encode type information remains poorly understood. We probe the residual streams of pretrained code models for internal type representations using a parallel dataset of Java and Python code examples. Our results show that cross-lingual type representations emerge even from untyped code. Moreover, we test whether hidden states linearly encode the result type implied by typed function application by training probes on one language to infer argument and result types in the other. Finally, we find that this structure is partly robust to lexical perturbations and cross-language syntactic variations. To the best of our knowledge, prior work on interpretability of code models has not directly targeted formal type semantics or cross-lingual type representations. We release our code and datasets.
2607.08339.paper_summary_zh: 最先進的程式碼模型達到了令人印象深刻的性能，但它們在內部編碼類型信息的程度仍然不甚了解。<lb/>我們使用一個並行的 Java 和 Python 程式碼示例數據集來探查預訓練程式碼模型的殘餘流，以獲取內部類型表示。<lb/>我們的結果顯示，即使是未類型化的程式碼，也會出現跨語言的類型表示。<lb/>此外，我們測試隱藏狀態是否線性編碼由類型函數應用所暗示的結果類型，通過在一種語言上訓練探針來推斷另一種語言中的參數和結果類型。<lb/>最後，我們發現這種結構對詞彙擾動和跨語言語法變異具有一定的穩健性。<lb/>據我們所知，之前關於程式碼模型可解釋性的研究並未直接針對形式類型語義或跨語言類型表示。<lb/>我們發布了我們的程式碼和數據集。
